milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate the jungle sign placed at [-5, 0, 7] (spawn-relative), approximately 8.6 blocks from spawn. The player must turn south and walk to find it. Max_distance=10 ensures the player has navigated toward it, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are visually observing the sign. A torch is placed adjacent for visibility.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate the beacon at [0, 0, -8] (spawn-relative). The beacon has a proper 3x3 iron pyramid base and open sky (air column to y=50), producing a visible beam that guides the player. Max_distance=12 and facing_tolerance=60 ensure the player has navigated to the central plaza and is looking at the beacon/beam.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate the stone stairs at [5-7, 0-2, -8 to -9], east of the beacon plaza. Target is the middle stair at [6, 1, -8]. Max_distance=8 ensures proximity and facing_tolerance=60 ensures visual confirmation of the staircase.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate the gravel path west of the beacon. The gravel includes raised pillars at [-5, 0, -8] for eye-level visibility. Target is this raised pillar. Facing_tolerance=120 is used (more generous than 60 since gravel extends across a path area, but not 180 which would require no facing at all). Max_distance=8 ensures the player has navigated to the western path.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate the smooth sandstone stairs at [-9 to -11, 0-2, -14 to -15], at the end of the gravel path. Target is the middle stair at [-10, 1, -14]. Max_distance=8 and facing_tolerance=60 ensure the player has followed the gravel path and is visually observing the desert wing entrance stairs.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate the stone brick walls forming the upper level room at [8-13, 3-6, -6 to -12]. Target is the room entrance center at [10, 3, -6]. The player must climb the stone stairs to reach this level. Max_distance=8 and facing_tolerance=60 ensure the player is on or near the upper level and facing the stone brick structure.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate the polished granite floor at [8-13, 2, -6 to -12] on the upper level. Target is the center of the floor at [10, 2, -9]. Max_distance=6 ensures the player is actually on the upper platform. Facing_tolerance=120 is used because it's a floor surface (player may look somewhat downward), but not 180 to require at least a general orientation toward the floor area.

Uses inventory_has because mining white_terracotta with a pickaxe drops the block as an item that ends up in the player's inventory. The player has a wooden_pickaxe (sufficient for terracotta, hardness 1.25). White terracotta blocks are embedded in the back wall of the upper room at [9-12, 3-4, -11]. Successfully mining at least one block places it in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because the final crafted item (orange_carpet) ends up in the player's inventory. This is a two-step craft: (1) orange_dye + white_wool → orange_wool, (2) 2 orange_wool → 3 orange_carpet. The player starts with 4 orange_dye and 4 white_wool, and a crafting table is at [11, 3, -8] on the upper level. Checking for min_count=1 orange_carpet confirms successful completion of the full crafting chain.

Uses inventory_has because the final crafted item (oak_slab) ends up in the player's inventory. This is a two-step craft: (1) oak_log → 4 oak_planks, (2) 3 oak_planks → 6 oak_slabs. The player starts with 4 oak_logs, and a crafting table is at [-14, 3, -16] in the desert wing room. Checking for min_count=1 oak_slab confirms successful completion of the full crafting chain.
